title: Rename a list at once
summary: A file listing renames, one `<symbol> => <new name>` a line, makes them all in one run
prose:
Every line is planned against the same index and the files are written once,
all of the renames or none of them. Blank lines and lines starting with `//`
are skipped.

files.text:
// API cleanup
compute => evaluate

Widget => Gadget
use => apply
